fields.Name: T119 - Integrations Connections Card Grid
fields.Description: Opens the Integrations app's Connections section once, then walks its bespoke card-grid UX (add-connection wizard, configure slide-in, delete confirmation overlay, sync-direction menu), verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T289, T293-T295.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, scroll the full list to find and open the Integrations application, then open its 'Integrations' (Connections) section. Then walk these sections IN ORDER, and as you arrive at each set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) add-connection-wizard - click the 'Add Integration' button (top-right) or the dashed '+ Add Integration' card, confirm an inline multi-step wizard opens with a step indicator ('Choose Integration', 'Configure', 'Test') and Step 1 shows a 'Search integrations...' box above a picker grid of integration cards; type a few letters in the search box and confirm the grid narrows or shows a no-match message (do NOT complete the wizard), then close the wizard; (2) configure-slide-in - on a connection card click the 'Configure' button in the card footer, confirm a slide-in panel titled 'Configure Integration' opens with a 'Connection Name' field, a 'Status' Active/Inactive toggle, a 'Credential' section, and 'Save Changes'/'Cancel' buttons, then click Cancel to close it (empty state acceptable if no connections); (3) delete-confirm-overlay - on a connection card click the trash-can delete icon in the card footer, confirm an inline confirmation overlay appears reading 'Delete this integration and all its entity maps?' with 'Delete' and 'Cancel' buttons, then click Cancel to dismiss it - do NOT click Delete; (4) sync-direction-menu - on an ACTIVE connection card click the 'Sync' button's caret/chevron to open its dropdown, confirm it groups sync options ('Pull (External -> MJ)', 'Push (MJ -> External)', 'Bidirectional', each with Incremental and Full variants) - only verify the menu renders, do NOT click any sync option (empty/inactive state acceptable). Keep going until every section has been visited. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait for content rather than navigating away.

checkpoints.name: add-connection-wizard
checkpoints.instruction: open the Add Integration wizard and search in Step 1
visualCriteria: The Add Integration wizard opens inline with a step indicator listing Choose Integration, Configure, and Test; Step 1 shows a search box and an integration picker grid (or a clear 'no integrations configured' state) and typing in the search narrows the grid or shows a no-match message

checkpoints.name: configure-slide-in
checkpoints.instruction: open the Configure slide-in panel and cancel
visualCriteria: Clicking Configure on a connection card opens a slide-in panel titled 'Configure Integration' with a Connection Name field, a Status toggle, a Credential section, and Save Changes / Cancel buttons, and clicking Cancel closes the panel - OR a valid empty state is shown

checkpoints.name: delete-confirm-overlay
checkpoints.instruction: trigger and cancel the inline delete-confirm overlay
visualCriteria: Clicking the trash icon on a connection card shows an inline overlay warning about deleting the integration and its entity maps with Delete and Cancel buttons, and clicking Cancel dismisses the overlay leaving the card - OR a valid empty state is shown

checkpoints.name: sync-direction-menu
checkpoints.instruction: open the multi-direction Sync menu without triggering a sync
visualCriteria: Clicking the Sync caret on an active connection card opens a dropdown with Pull, Push, and Bidirectional groups, each offering Incremental and Full variants; the menu is only opened, not acted on - OR a valid empty/inactive state is shown
